Hypercars have seen a similar increase, representing 32 percent of the auction market, with both segments being driven in large part by the demand for highly desirable Ferrari models.

Broad Arrow Auctions has released another highly desirable lineup of Ferrari hypercars and supercars for its upcoming second annual Las Vegas Auction, set for October 31 in partnership with Concours at Wynn Las Vegas.
Latest highlights are led by a
, chassis number 314846, finished in the exquisite Tailor Made shade of

interior. Offered from its original owner, the curator of an exceptional private collection, the SP3 is one of just 600 examples produced and displays just 81 miles at cataloging. The second model in Ferrari’s sought after “Icona” series, the Daytona SP3 is many things—a rolling tribute to one of the marque’s most triumphant afternoons, a showcase of naturally aspirated engineering at its peak, and quite possibly the final chapter in a mid-engine, naturally aspirated lineage that began nearly sixty years ago. The car on offer is equipped with numerous carbon fiber elements, airbrushed fender shield, a suspension lifter, and a full complement of factory accessories.
“The collector car market has quickly recognized the significance of the Daytona SP3 in Ferrari’s history,” says
Barney Ruprecht, Vice President of Auctions for Broad Arrow

. “In the few short years since the SP3's reveal, values have climbed sharply, reflecting both the model's extreme exclusivity, and a growing understanding that it may represent the final expression Ferrari’s naturally aspirated V12 for the road. This is a particularly special example of the 600 made, with a bespoke specification that’s sure to appeal to today’s most discerning collectors.”
Additional thrilling Ferrari highlights coming to Broad Arrow Las Vegas Auction include:

This is a low-mileage, extensively specified example of the first hybrid hypercar from Maranello, producing a combined 950 horsepower from its 6.3-liter V12 hybrid powerplant. One of approximately 120 examples delivered new to the US, the LaFerrari on offer is finished in iconic

accents, recently serviced, and accompanied by its battery charger, fitted car cover, and tool kit. It is offered with a two-year Certified Pre-Owned warranty, including coverage of its hybrid battery, valid through October 2028.

One of only 111 delivered new to the US market, this true driver’s example of Ferrari’s singular turn-of-the-century hypercar shows under 18,000 miles at cataloging. It has been refinished by Carrozzeria Zanasi in Maranello to its original Rosso Corsa and features a Pelle Nera interior. Classiche certified and serviced in 2026 by Ferrari Dallas at a cost exceeding $10,000, this is an eminently usable example of the iconic hypercar that carries the legacy of Enzo Ferrari, prepared to be enjoyed the way its namesake intended.
This exceptionally rare supercar is one of only 80 special series SA Aperta models produced in celebration of Pininfarina’s 80th anniversary. Finished in classic
details, it is offered in near-new condition with just 745 miles, $87,000 in optional extras, and an exhilarating zero-to-62 miles per hour time of 3.6 seconds with a top speed of 202 miles per hour.

The LaFerrari is a well-cared-for example of an essential acquisition—one of the most significant Ferraris ever built.

The market for modern Ferrari supercars is looking stronger than ever, and Broad Arrow is proud to be entrusted by both buyers and sellers to secure new homes for these spectacular pieces of motoring history. Those interested in the sale or purchase of a Ferrari through either Broad Arrow Auctions or Private Sales are invited to contact a Broad Arrow Car Specialist via info@broadarrowauctions.com or by calling +1 313-312-0780 in North America or +44-2045-920-16 in EMEA.

Broad Arrow Auctions, driven by Hagerty

, is a leading global collector car auction house founded in 2021 by industry veterans. As the fastest-growing auction house in its segment, Broad Arrow connects exceptional collector cars with enthusiasts worldwide through flagship events including The Broad Arrow Quail Auction (the official auction of The Quail by The Peninsula, A Motorsports Gathering), The Amelia Auction (the official auction of The Amelia Concours), The Porsche Auction in collaboration with Air | Water by Luftgekühlt, the Las Vegas Auction in partnership with Concours at Wynn Las Vegas, as well as international auctions held in partnership with Concorso d’Eleganza Villa d’Este, Zoute Grand Prix, and Auto Zürich.
Learn more at broadarrowauctions.com and follow us on Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Twitter.

Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers, protecting 2.8 million vehicles in the United States, Canada and the UK. We make it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love through innovative insurance products, live and digital auctions, engaging media and events, as well as the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest community of car lovers. For more information, please visit www.hagerty.com or www.newsroom.hagerty.com.

The Hagerty Automotive Intelligence team uses their collector car expertise to analyse Hagerty's massive trove of public auction results, private sales and insurance data, and buyer and seller behaviour. Learn more about how we collect our data at hagerty.com/valuation-tools.
